meta.name: Toy Boy
meta.description:
After seven years in a Málaga prison, a male stripper is released pending retrial and sets out to prove his lover framed him for her husband's murder.

Rated TV-MA · Canceled · First aired 8 Sept 2019 · Spain · Language: Spanish · 70 min
Studio: Atresmedia, Plano a Plano · Network: Atresplayer

Complete series. On your server: S1 13/13 | S2 8/8

On your server — Audio: English, Spanish, Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: After seven years in prison, a male stripper is unexpectedly granted a retrial. Released on parole, he hunts for proof that he was framed for murder.

videos.title: Among the Dead
videos.overview: Hugo finds a way to get a close look at the coroner's wrecked car. Triana follows a suspicious money trail to Melilla. Andrea makes an unlikely friend.

videos.title: The Final Judgement
videos.overview: When Andrea hints that his accident on the night of the murder was a coverup, Hugo searches in hospital records to see if Macarena's alibi checks out.

videos.title: Square One
videos.overview: Hugo scrambles to hide the fact that he left Inferno at the time of the new murder. Andrea is approached by an old friend's mother, who makes a plea.

videos.title: The Murderer's Pulse
videos.overview: Triana notices Philip's smartwatch is missing from police evidence, then realizes its data is likely on the cloud. Macarena learns more about Álvaro.

videos.title: End of the Tunnel
videos.overview: An ID is made on the body found on the boat, but doubt leads Hugo to check its veracity. Macarena discovers Álvaro's mother knows her son's whereabouts.

videos.title: Masquerade
videos.overview: Under hypnosis, Hugo remembers key details of the night he was framed. Philip's smartwatch is found. Claudia must choose between her husband and Iván.

videos.title: Sole Witness
videos.overview: Iván makes sudden travel plans. A new police commissioner takes Zapata by surprise. Andrea receives an unexpected gift from his Uncle Mateo.

videos.title: Mother's Love
videos.overview: Hugo steals from his captor evidence that leads him to the killer behind the charred body. Andrea calls Jairo for help. Óscar gets a tempting job offer.

videos.title: Polaroids
videos.overview: Andrea receives a threatening message. Macarena is directed to a safe containing a mysterious flash drive. Zapata forces Iván to do a favor for him.

videos.title: Young Pup
videos.overview: Macarena is stunned by a betrayal. Triana gives the commissioner the evidence from the gas station. Jairo receives a lucrative offer.

videos.title: Redemption
videos.overview: Triana discovers Iván is hiding a secret about Inferno. When Andrea's flash drive is stolen from Jairo, the Inferno gang go undercover to get it back.

videos.title: Fallen Angels
videos.overview: The Irish mafia come looking for the money taken from their club. A video is leaked to the press. Hugo comes face-to-face with the rapist-murderer.

videos.title: The Person You Love the Most
videos.overview: Hugo aggressively searches for answers about who bombed Inferno. Macarena starts making amends. The strippers perform for a new client.

videos.title: What Is Sex for You?
videos.overview: Despite Iván's objections, Hugo takes a risk while investigating Rania. Macarena is curious to learn more about El Turco.

videos.title: The Price of the Gods
videos.overview: Rania tries to find a missing David before her brother. Hugo goes against his moral code in order to pay for Triana's medical care.

videos.title: Heaven and Hell
videos.overview: El Turco uses unorthodox methods to woo Macarena. Meanwhile, his sister gets closer to Iván. Andrea shows off his film idea inspired by Jairo.

videos.title: Desecrated Temples
videos.overview: Triana struggles to regain her strength. El Turco desperately searches for Rania and the trail he follows leads to a stunning accusation.

videos.title: A Grand Gesture
videos.overview: A visit from an old friend surprises Hugo. After consulting with his lawyer, Andrea makes a decision about his future. El Turco plans a grand gesture.

videos.title: Why Do They Call Me the Turk?
videos.overview: Hugo tries to help Darío find work. Behind El Turco's back, an unexpected alliance forms against him. Borja has a difficult request for Macarena.

videos.title: Opportunities
videos.overview: Macarena and El Turco prepare for their wedding day. Hugo and Triana find themselves in a dangerous situation. Andrea is dealt a crushing blow.
